qualifier: p53- and DREAM/RB-family transcriptional repression
name: p53 and DREAM control of G2/M progression
rationale: Members concern transcriptional repression of cell cycle genes by DREAM/p107/p130 and p53 plus G2/M progression (GTSE1, MASTL), unlike confusables centred on APC/C mitotic exit, G1/S RB defects or cyclin B/PLK G2/M events.

qualifier: histone, protein and DNA methylation with heterochromatin silencing
name: Chromatin remodeling and histone/DNA methylation
rationale: Members cover BAF/CHD/NuRD remodelers and histone-modifying enzymes, with a strong methylation and heterochromatin/imprinting/X-inactivation component that the acetylation-oriented confusables lack.

qualifier: disuse/inactivity-induced, SCF ubiquitin-ligase dependent
name: Disuse-induced skeletal muscle atrophy
rationale: All members describe muscle wasting in response to inactivity and its SCF-proteasome control, whereas confusables concern hypertrophy, cardiac adaptation or myoblast differentiation.

qualifier: SOS-mediated exchange and GAP/NF1 control, including oncogenic mutants
name: RAS GTPase cycle control by SOS and GAPs
rationale: Members centre on RAS loading by SOS/SHC and inactivation by GAPs/NF1 and their mutants, upstream of the RAF, RSK and ERK-feedback content in confusables.

qualifier: peroxides, ischemia and ferroptosis
name: Cellular response to peroxides, ischemia and ferroptosis
rationale: Members are responses to hydrogen peroxide/hydroperoxide, ischemia, H2S and iron-dependent ferroptosis, unlike confusables about nitrosative stress, apoptosis regulation or respiration.

qualifier: ETS/ITS spacer endonucleolytic cleavage with Pol I rRNA transcription
name: Pre-rRNA spacer cleavage and Pol I rRNA transcription
rationale: Members are endonucleolytic cleavages of the tricistronic precursor plus positive Pol I transcription, distinct from Pol I/III elongation-termination or ribosome assembly confusables.

qualifier: SHOC2-MRAS complexes and oncogenic RAF/MEK point mutants
name: RAF-MEK activation and oncogenic RAF/MEK mutant signaling
rationale: Members cover RAF activation, MAP2K/MAPK activation and BRAF/RAF1/MAP2K/MRAS mutant signaling, lacking the integrin linkage, fusions, RSK or ERK-feedback content of confusables.

qualifier: co-expressed gene modules rather than specific transport reactions
name: Plasma membrane SLC transporter co-expression modules
rationale: All members are transcriptional modules enriched for plasma-membrane SLC and ion transporters, whereas confusables are specific organic cation, urate or amino acid transport processes.

qualifier: transition and heavy metals (Zn, Cu, Mn, Cd) beyond iron and heme
name: Transition and heavy metal ion uptake, homeostasis and detoxification
rationale: Members span iron/heme handling plus zinc, copper, manganese, cadmium and other metal transport, sensing and metallothionein detoxification, which the iron/heme-, oxygen- or vitamin-centred confusables lack.

qualifier: capping, telomerase Cajal body recruitment and recombination suppression
name: Telomere capping, telomerase recruitment and recombination suppression
rationale: Members address telomerase assembly/Cajal body trafficking, telomere capping and suppression of recombination/NHEJ at telomeres, unlike confusables centred on C-strand replication and D-loop disassembly.

qualifier: MTF1-driven, cadmium detoxification
name: MTF1-metallothionein response to cadmium and heavy metals
rationale: Members are metallothionein/MTF1 responses to zinc, copper, mercury, iron and especially cadmium transport and detoxification, which confusables lacking cadmium or MTF1 do not combine.

qualifier: with centromeric CENP-A chromatin deposition
name: Sister chromatid cohesion, chromosome condensation and CENP-A deposition
rationale: Members cover cohesin loading/resolution, chromosome condensation and CENP-A nucleosome deposition, distinct from spindle, meiotic recombination or general nucleosome assembly confusables.

qualifier: VEGF-neuropilin and angiopoietin-Tie2 for endothelial survival
name: VEGF and angiopoietin-Tie2 signaling in endothelial survival
rationale: Members are VEGF/VEGFR/neuropilin and Tie2 signaling, lymphangiogenesis and endothelial anti-apoptosis, unlike confusables about sprouting angiogenesis regulation and VEGFR2 signaling.

qualifier: carnitine-dependent, medium/long-chain
name: Carnitine-dependent medium/long-chain fatty acid metabolism
rationale: Members cover carnitine shuttle/transport and medium- and long-chain fatty acid and acyl-CoA metabolism, lacking the ketone body and individual beta-oxidation step content of confusables.

qualifier: Wnt and Hedgehog ligand acylation and secretion
name: Protein palmitoylation and acylation of Wnt and Hedgehog ligands
rationale: Members are S-palmitoylation/depalmitoylation and PORCN/HHAT acylation enabling Wnt and Hh-Np secretion, unlike confusables on prenylation, Hh autoprocessing or Wnt-Ca2+ signaling.

qualifier: SENP-mediated SUMO processing and deconjugation
name: SENP-mediated SUMO processing, deconjugation and substrate SUMOylation
rationale: Members are SUMO maturation, desumoylation and SUMOylation of non-transcriptional substrates, unlike confusables featuring E1/E2 conjugation, transcription factor, chromatin or replication-protein targets.

qualifier: with sympathoadrenal development
name: Monoamine neurotransmitter metabolism, transport and sympathoadrenal development
rationale: Members cover catecholamine/serotonin synthesis, uptake, vesicular loading and MAO/COMT degradation plus adrenal and sympathetic development, unlike confusables on GABA/glutamate/ACh, BH4 or dopamine receptor signaling.

qualifier: brown/beige, with negative regulation of adipose development
name: Brown and beige adipocyte differentiation and negative adipogenic regulation
rationale: Members are brown/beige fat differentiation (EBF2) and negative regulation of fat cell proliferation, adipose development, PPAR signaling and thermogenesis, unlike white-adipogenesis or cold-response confusables.

qualifier: monocyte, macrophage and dendritic cell lineage regulation
name: Regulation of monocyte, macrophage, dendritic and granulocyte differentiation
rationale: Members regulate myeloid lineage differentiation with emphasis on monocyte/macrophage/DC and GM-CSF response, unlike confusables focused on neutrophil/G-CSF, progenitors or M-CSF proliferation.

qualifier: with Na+/H+ exchange and osmotic cell volume response
name: Cation-chloride cotransport and Na+/H+ exchange in osmoregulation
rationale: Members are SLC12 cotransporters, NHE exchangers, K+ channels and hyper/hypotonic responses, unlike confusables on synaptic, K+ channel regulation or bicarbonate/SLC26 anion exchange.

qualifier: Leloir pathway and its inherited defects
name: Leloir pathway galactose catabolism and galactosemias
rationale: All members concern the Leloir pathway and GALT/GALM deficiencies, distinct from fructose, pentose or gluconeogenic confusables.

qualifier: glycine/glutamine conjugation of aromatic acids
name: Amino acid conjugation of aromatic acids and organic acid metabolism
rationale: Members are glycine/glutamine conjugation of benzoate, salicylate and phenylacetate with general organic acid/amide metabolism, which the amino acid catabolism confusables lack.

qualifier: DVL activation and destruction complex disassembly
name: Wnt-induced DVL activation and destruction complex disassembly
rationale: Members are early ligand-driven activation steps of canonical Wnt signaling, unlike confusables about destruction complex mutants, beta-catenin phosphorylation or target gene repression.

qualifier: TNFR1-driven, with transcription factor activity regulation
name: TNFR1 signaling and canonical NF-kappaB transcription factor activity
rationale: Members are TNFR1 NF-kappaB/proapoptotic signaling, linear ubiquitination and positive/negative NF-kappaB transcription factor activity, unlike TLR-, necroptosis- or non-canonical NF-kappaB confusables.

qualifier: monocarboxylates, glucose, carnitine and creatine buffering
name: Energy substrate transport: monocarboxylates, glucose, carnitine and creatine
rationale: Members move lactate/pyruvate, glucose, carnitine and ATP and include creatine/phosphocreatine metabolism, unlike confusables on organic anion, TCA intermediate or fatty acid transport.
